note: Controlled and fault-injected cases. Mechanism labels are recorded per case: 'crafted by observer' (artifact crafted, no child), 'fault-injected child' (child instructed to deviate), 'real reproduction' (environment reproduced the failure), 'instructed' (unavailability stated in the environment), 'controlled replay' (reused recorded inputs). Fixture scenarios 5b, 7, 9a-9c, 10a-10c, 11, 12, 13.

5b-interrupted-child.mechanism: real interruption analog: the child (background session ses_f305c4acbffeOwIpefHshjuidn) was dispatched and its output channel severed before any artifact reached the host; the host wrote its BREAK record and closed the run before the child could deliver anything
5b-interrupted-child.observed: no captured artifact; the host named the missing/interrupted interpretation as the break; no ingest; no report under the run's private root; no state; no retry
5b-interrupted-child.runnerNote: this run's preparation directory was not materialized before dispatch (runner error, recorded); the host's stop is independent of what the child read or produced, and any late child completion is not this run's artifact

12-separate-roots-identical-rows.mechanism: controlled replay: the recorded 2a artifact bytes (sha256 af69caeb...) supplied byte-identically to two runs with different memo seeds; labeled controlled replay, no child dispatch
12-separate-roots-identical-rows.observed: run 12A: private root seeded from the 2a interpretations; run 12B: empty private root; both ingests exit 0, state coherent, 0 findings; the two reports are byte-identical (sha256 6fc475b1...) with identical identities (same export digest fa59eb1e..., same artifact digest 8e993046...) but live in SEPARATE roots — neither run's handback can substitute the other's report, and each result names its own root's path; after the runs, the workspace memo was mutated and both reports remain byte-identical to their post-run state; the seed is retained
